summary: First Phosphate Corp. filed a Form 6-K with an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate and technical report for its Bégin-Lamarche phosphate project in Quebec, along with a press release. No special-situation transaction is present; the filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of technical mining data. The report, prepared by P&E Mining Consultants, updates resource figures but involves no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event. This is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
